test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number, symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. All numbers are single-digit numbers only.

(Left) 3 @ © 6 5 € € 3 3 8 € % 2 7 6 # 7 * £ € 9 $ (Right)

How many such symbols are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 3 @ © 6 5 € € 3 3 8 € % 2 7 6 # 7 * £ € 9 $ (Right)

Now,

Symbols, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, the needed pattern is: Number — Symbol — Number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b61f5146724f5cede9969dfb332310dd94c8454e399d8eab93f4caceb653b387.png] 

Thus, there is one such symbol, which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
